Backend Engineer, Bluefin Logistics — Dec 2023 - Present
Implemented and maintained microservices for shipment tracking and ETA calculation using Django and FastAPI. Designed and optimized PostgreSQL schemas and queries for high-volume tracking data, reducing average query time by 35%. Built Redis-backed caching layers to serve real-time status updates to clients, cutting API response latency by 40%. Integrated background job processing with Celery for asynchronous tasks and used Git for code collaboration and CI workflows.

Software Engineer - Backend, Medisure — Sep 2023 - Nov 2023
Developed RESTful APIs with Django for patient record synchronization and appointment workflows. Containerized services with Docker for consistent deployments across staging and production. Implemented Celery workers to handle notification delivery and batch processing, improving throughput of background jobs by 25%. Collaborated via Git in a small cross-functional team to ship incremental releases.

Python Developer, Quanta Retail — Aug 2022 - Aug 2023
Built inventory reconciliation and order processing services in Python 3. Implemented Celery-based task queues and Redis as broker/result backend to manage high-concurrency batch jobs, reducing failed job rate by 30%. Containerized applications with Docker for scalable deployments and used Postgres for transactional data storage. Managed code and feature branches using Git.

Skills: Python 3, Django, FastAPI, Postgres, Redis, Docker, Celery, Git
